name: Tacos el Carnalito
tagline: Trompo and fajita tacos at night on Austin Street.
about: Tacos el Carnalito at 146 Austin St in Hempstead opens in the evening and serves until midnight.
Regulars order the trompo and fajita tacos, al pastor, and the baked potato topped with fajita, with horchata on the side.
